hook: One fake investment scheme stole $91 million before federal judges stepped in.

sections.voiceover: One fake investment scheme stole $91 million before federal judges stepped in.
Dallas-Fort Worth residents Kenneth Alexander and Robert Welsh ran the Vanguard JV Cash Program. Over 200 investors poured their life savings into the trap. Where did all that money vanish?
The Securities and Exchange Commission charged them over the Vanguard JV Cash Program.
Texas judges entered final consent judgments against the perpetrators. Defendant Caedrynn Conner now faces an $8,575,250 disgorgement order.
The U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Texas entered final consent judgments.
